Most New Exporters Don't Fail From Lack of Effort

They fail because nobody shows them what to do first, and in what order.

You keep jumping between productsEvery week a new idea, and none of them moves forward.
You don't know which country to targetEveryone says USA or Europe, but is that right for your product?
You bought buyer lists that never repliedHundreds of emails, zero orders, and money spent on data.

✈️ From failures to a framework
My story

From a ₹10,000 Family to Helping 150+ Exporters

I didn't start with money, contacts or a famous surname. I started from a family that knew the value of every ₹10,000.

My early export attempts failed. I chased the wrong products, wrote to the wrong buyers and depended on lists that never worked. Each failure taught me something no course had taught me.

“I turned my own export failures into the practical training model I teach today.”

That model became the D-E-X-O-N Framework. It focuses on one product, one country and one clear plan, with no cold-calling marathons and no dependence on B2B portals. Today, with a team of 15+ years' experience behind me, I help first-time exporters across India do it the right way from day one.

Sunny ChobyFounder, Dexon International · Chandigarh–Mohali

5 simple steps from "I'm confused" to your first export order, and then the next one.

Questions

Frequently Asked Questions

I don't have a product yet. Can you help?

Yes. We help you find the best product within 300 km of your area, chosen to suit you and your budget.

I'm completely new to export. Is this for me?

Yes. Everything we do is built for first-time exporters, including people who haven't finalised a product or a country yet.

I don't have an IEC or a registered company yet. Can I still start?

Yes. We tell you which documents you need, like IEC and GST, and in what order, so you don't waste time or money.

Will you give me a buyer list?

No. A list alone rarely brings a first order. We teach you how to find, qualify and approach buyers yourself, so you never depend on anyone.

What's the difference between the call and the Handholding Program?

The ₹1,499 call gives you clarity and a plan in 40 minutes. The 6-month Handholding Program means Sunny and the team work with you, step by step, until your first shipment.

Can you guarantee an export order?

Honestly, nobody can guarantee an order. What we guarantee is clarity, a proven framework and real support. The results come from following the plan.

In which language do you teach?

Calls and mentorship are in Hindi, so you can ask every question freely.

How do I book and pay for the 1:1 call?

Tap any "Book My 1:1 Call" button, enter your name and WhatsApp number, and you'll see the full call details. Then pick a free time slot and pay ₹1,499 securely online. Your booking is confirmed instantly.

What do I get after the call?

An Export Strategy PDF, a step-by-step checklist, a First Export Order Roadmap, the lifetime recording of your call, and 15 days of WhatsApp support for your questions.

Can I start exporting while I'm doing a job?

Yes. Many of our clients start alongside a job or another business. We plan the steps around the time you actually have.

How much money do I need to start?

It depends on your product and country. We look at your budget first, then choose a product and market that fit it, so you start small and safe.

Is the Handholding Program a recorded course?

No. It's live, personal mentorship: 2 months directly with Sunny and 4 months of team support, working on your own product and buyers until your first shipment.
